name: KimiKiss Ato Chotto Omake Gekijou
original_name: キミキス あとちょっとおまけ劇場
source:
This short episode was released for a limited time on the official KimiKiss website to celebrate the game's second anniversary. It follows Nana and Narumi Satonaka as they visit a game studio. 

Since the download link has been removed and, unlike Chotto Matome Gekijou, it was never released on physical media, the episode is no longer officially available.
translation:
This short episode was released for a limited time on the official KimiKiss website to celebrate the game's second anniversary. It follows Nana and Narumi Satonaka as they visit a game studio. 

Since the download link has been removed and, unlike Chotto Matome Gekijou, it was never released on physical media, the episode is no longer officially available.
